name: mojo
description: Teach coding agents to write idiomatic, correct, performant, current Mojo (Modular's language)

interface.longDescription: Helps agents write, port, review, and optimize Mojo. Carries the Mojo 1.1 old-to-current map (def not fn, var/imm/mut not owned/read/inout, comptime not alias, Pointer with unsafe_ operations, max.gpu not std.gpu, TestSuite not mojo test) plus short verified references for memory and CPU performance, GPU kernels (DeviceContext, TileTensor, warps), and Python interop and extension modules.
defaultPrompt: Write a Mojo struct with SIMD ops
Port this Python function to Mojo
Write a GPU kernel in Mojo
